course_name_original: GESTION DEL DISEÑO Y LA INNOVACION

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to assimilate the functional, technical, and economic aspects of the innovation and design process as a whole.
Development of creative skills and mechanisms for adaptation, motivation, and collaboration (teamwork).
Ability to organize, plan, manage, and collaborate in competitive innovation and design processes.
Effective communication, both written and oral, of knowledge, procedures, results, and ideas.
Ability to work in unidisciplinary, multidisciplinary, or multicultural teams.
Ability to follow the phases of strategic design definition.
Ability for analysis, critical thinking, and synthesis.

syllabus_topics: Strategic analysis. Innovation as a strategic alternative.
The conceptual framework of technological innovation and knowledge management.
Organizational Design for design and innovation.
teaching_methods: Creativity and new product ideas workshop

assessment_methods.method: First Part Design and Innovation Work
Second Part Design and Innovation Work

assessment_rules: Continuous assessment is based on a First Partial Exam (30%), a Second Partial Exam (30%), a First Part Design and Innovation Work (20%), and a Second Part Design and Innovation Work (20%). A minimum grade of 5/10 is required for each partial exam to pass continuous evaluation. If continuous evaluation is not passed, a final exam (100% of the grade) or an extraordinary call exam (100% of the grade) must be taken. Both exams consist of multiple-choice tests and/or theoretical or practical questions, including case studies.
